title: How Democratic Opposition Emerged from Print
grammar: Agentless nominalization and systemic attribution (közzétételre kerül, nyilvánosságra hozatal)
goal: I can say what the samizdat journal Beszélő published from 1981 and what part it played in the opposition's work.
I can use agentless nominalized event structures (közzétételre kerül, nyilvánosságra hozatala) in formal analysis.
I can sum up in Hungarian how samizdat publishing challenged state censorship.
